$\,$ $P(x):$ $x-7<-9$" :question/worked-solution "The truth set of $¬P(x)$ is the *complement* of the truth set of $P(x):$

$$
{T}_{¬P}={\overset{―}{T}}_{P}
$$

To find the the truth set of $P(x),$ we solve the inequality:

$$
\begin{aligned}x-7 & <-9 \\ x & <-2\end{aligned}
$$

So, the truth set of $P(x)$ is
${T}_{P}=(-\infty ,-2).$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{T}_{¬P} & ={\overset{―}{T}}_{P} \\  & =\overset{―}{(-\infty ,-2)} \\  & =[-2,\infty ).\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["answer-field-756361aa-d5cf-55f5-9c74-7d766195b840"] :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id "answer-field-756361aa-d5cf-55f5-9c74-7d766195b840" :answer-field/id #uuid "756361aa-d5cf-55f5-9c74-7d766195b840" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/correct "answer-6d8e47ef-6800-5c53-99fc-6fcc124ca2f5" :answer-field/choices ["answer-2e0baf9c-dfdb-50b1-8d2c-f2950159bc02" "answer-54737426-e934-5b9e-a7e3-ee8d5c4c5497" "answer-18f25b9b-3d35-56ca-9327-f8285b1ec334" "answer-a6a130d7-695f-5eff-b612-a89637d42af1" "answer-6d8e47ef-6800-5c53-99fc-6fcc124ca2f5"] :db/ensure [:answer-field/validate]} {:db/id "answer-2e0baf9c-dfdb-50b1-8d2c-f2950159bc02" :answer/id #uuid "2e0baf9c-dfdb-50b1-8d2c-f2950159bc02" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "(-2,\infty )" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-54737426-e934-5b9e-a7e3-ee8d5c4c5497" :answer/id #uuid "54737426-e934-5b9e-a7e3-ee8d5c4c5497" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "(-\infty ,-2]" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-18f25b9b-3d35-56ca-9327-f8285b1ec334" :answer/id #uuid "18f25b9b-3d35-56ca-9327-f8285b1ec334" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "(-\infty ,2)" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-a6a130d7-695f-5eff-b612-a89637d42af1" :answer/id #uuid "a6a130d7-695f-5eff-b612-a89637d42af1" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "(-\infty ,2]" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-6d8e47ef-6800-5c53-99fc-6fcc124ca2f5" :answer/id #uuid "6d8e47ef-6800-5c53-99fc-6fcc124ca2f5" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "[-2,\infty )" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id 17592186199522 :tutorial/content "The **negation** of the predicate $P(x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_n)$ is a new predicate that we denote as follows:

$$
\lnot P(x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_n)
$$

This predicate is true if and only if $P$ is false for a specific set of assignment variables $x_1,x_2, \ldots x_n.$

For example, consider the following predicate defined over the universal set $\mathbb Z.$

$\qquad$ *$P(m):$ $m$ is even*

Then, $\lnot P(m)$ is a new predicate that reads as follows:

$\qquad$ *$m$ is **not** even*

This can be simplified as:

$\qquad$ *$m$ is odd*

For example:

- $P(2)$ is true while $\lnot P(2)$ is false

- $P(3)$ is false while $\lnot P(3)$ is true" :db/ensure [:tutorial/validate]} {:db/id 17592186199543 :tutorial/content "Let $T_P$ be the truth set of the predicate $P(x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_n).$

From the definition of the negation of a predicate, we have that $\lnot P$ is true if and only if $P$ is false. Therefore, the truth set of $\neg P$ is the *complement* of the truth set of $P{:}$

$$
T_{\neg P} = \overline{T}_P
$$

For example, consider the following predicate defined over the universal set $\mathbb{R}{:}$

$P(x):$ $-2x +3 \leq 5$

To find the the truth set of $P(x),$ we solve the inequality:

$$
\begin{aligned}-2x+3 & \le 5 \\ -2x & \le 2 \\ x & \ge -1\end{aligned}
$$

So, the truth set of $P(x)$ is $T_P = [-1,\infty).$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{T}_{¬P} & ={\overset{―}{T}}_{P} \\  & =\overset{―}{[-1,\infty )} \\  & =(-\infty ,-1).\end{aligned}
$$" :db/ensure [:tutorial/validate]} {:db/id 17592186198515 :activity/expected-seconds 420.0 :db/ensure [:activity/validate]}]

$P(x):$ $-2x +3 \leq 5$

To find the the truth set of $P(x),$ we solve the inequality:

$$\begin{aligned}-2x+3 & \le 5 \\ -2x & \le 2 \\ x & \ge -1\end{aligned}$$

So, the truth set of $P(x)$ is $T_P = [-1,\infty).$
